ApiVersion.description: The wire date this client speaks.
ApiVersion.name: Api-Version

AccountExport.description: Everything held about an account, in plain JSON.

oneOf.description:
Send a prepared request with this session's token. The http effect takes the id of
this event and its class is always plain, so whoever prepared it gets the answer
under that id. Tokens stay in the core.

AgeCard.description: Age card shown once at the start of play.

Attempt.description:
One way to play. Attempts arrive in the order to try, ranked once on the server.
`headers` is required, even when empty, and no provider name is carried.

expires_at_ms.description: Wall time, ms since 1970, after which the address stops working.

group.description: Opaque group. After a failure the core skips other attempts of this group.

headers.description: Headers the player must send, such as Referer, Origin, User-Agent.

verified.description: True when the finder fetched and read this address.

BodyTarget.description:
Where the body of an answer goes. An answer outside 200 to 299 always comes to the core,
because the core reads its error code.

BrandValues.description: Name and contact, filled into text at render time.

CapabilityCard.description: What a device can do. The server filters attempts and sections by this card.

adaptive.description: True when the player switches variants during play.

attempt_kinds.description: Attempt kinds this player opens. An embed appears only when listed here.

codecs.description: Codecs this player opens, such as avc1, hvc1, mp4a.

containers.description: Containers this player opens, such as ts, fmp4, mp4.

media_headers.description: Request headers the player can set on media, such as Referer.

reports_picture.description: True when the driver reports video width or has_picture.

secret_store.description: True when the device has a durable secret store.

section_kinds.description: Section kinds this build draws. Others fall back to a plain row.

side_subtitles.description: True when the player can load a side subtitle file.

storage_bytes.description: Bytes this device gives to kept commands and screens. 0 means none.

oneOf.description: Hidden as a whole, every episode of a series included.

ClientFloor.description: Lowest app version a class may run.

CodeSent.description: A code was sent, or would have been. The answer never says whether the account exists.

Command.description: One change to a profile's facts.

oneOf.description: Add to or remove from My List. Leaves the rating alone.
Set or clear a rating. Leaves the list entry alone.
Hide a title from history. For a series this covers every episode.
Clear all history of this profile, as one operation.
Save a position, in whole seconds.
Change one profile setting. Booleans as true or false, style as JSON text.
A viewer signal. Discarded by the server when consent is off.
A trailer failed to play for this title.

CommandAnswer.description: Answer for a batch, one entry per op.

CommandOp.description: One queued op. A missing `age_ms` means age unknown, and the server orders by arrival.

oneOf.description: Add to or remove from My List. Leaves the rating alone.
Set or clear a rating. Leaves the list entry alone.
Hide a title from history. For a series this covers every episode.
Clear all history of this profile, as one operation.
Save a position, in whole seconds.
Change one profile setting. Booleans as true or false, style as JSON text.
A viewer signal. Discarded by the server when consent is off.
A trailer failed to play for this title.

Confirm.description: Step up. Send a password or an emailed code.

Confirmed.description: A step up holds for this many seconds and a refresh never renews it.

CoreConfig.description: Given to `core_open`, once. The seed is the only random input the core ever gets.

card.description: What this device can do. The core sends its hash after sign in.

CoreIn.description: One step of input. Every input carries wall time and monotonic time.

mono_ms.description: Monotonic time, ms. Restarts at boot.

CoreMode.description: Where the core runs for this device.

next_wake_ms.description: Monotonic time at which the host steps the core again. Absent means no wake.

unsupported.description: Ids of in events of a type this core does not know.

Cursor.description: An opaque position in a list. Clients hand it back and never read it.

DeviceCardAnswer.description: True when the server wants the whole card.

DeviceCardRequest.description: Sent at each start. The card travels only when the server asks or the app or OS changed.

DeviceClass.description: Client class. Minimum versions, start deadlines and reachability are kept per class.

DeviceCode.description: Device sign in. The screen shows `user_code` even when it shows a QR code.

DevicePoll.description: Answers while a device waits for approval.

DeviceTokenAnswer.description: Either tokens or a word saying to wait or stop.

DriverCommand.description: A command to the player. Attempts carry their headers here.

DriverEvent.description: What the driver reports. No driver decides failover or no picture by itself.

has_picture.description: Absent means unknown, and the no picture rule stays off.

Effect.description: One effect. The result comes back as an event with this id.

oneOf.description: A path, never an address. The host holds the base address.

scope.description: Opaque scope of an account and profile, for kept copies.

oneOf.description: A one time notice or a kept page. Lasting state travels in `view`.

EpisodeRef.description: One episode of a series. A film has none.

ErrorClass.description: Failure classes a driver reports. The core picks the next attempt from these.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code. A code this build does not know reads as `Unknown`.

Event.description: One event. `id` is the id of the effect it answers, when it answers one.

oneOf.description: An http effect got an answer. Every status is data.

body.description: Absent when the body went to the screen.

oneOf.description: An http effect got no answer at all.
The host cannot perform this effect.
The effect with this id was dropped.
Touch, key, wheel or playing video in view.
An address or deep link to open.
A driver event, stamped with the generation of the open that made it.

Features.description: Feature values. With no answer from the server, accounts are required.

visitor_tier.description: Tier for visitors. Present only when accounts are not required.

FindAnswer.description: Answer, possibly partial when the budget ran out.

FindOutcome.description: How a search for sources ended.

FindRequest.description: Title facts come from the server, so a finder never looks them up.

budget_ms.description: Total time this search may take.

Form.description: The form a client draws in. A browser on a phone is class web, form phone.

FoundSource.description: One source as facts. The server turns these into ranked attempts.

GateView.description: True while the who is watching prompt should show.

playback.description: False stops playback everywhere with a notice.

HostedStep.description: `POST /v1/core/step`. `config` is sent on the first step of a hosted session.

HttpClass.description: How an http effect may be handled.

oneOf.description: Must reach the server. The offline layer keeps it when one is present.
May be answered from a kept copy.
The host performs it as it arrives.

Image.description: One image address. Images go straight from the host to the viewer.

Limits.description: Limits served from one place, so no client holds a copy.

ListState.description: List state of a title, versioned apart from its rating.

MarksRequest.description: Ask for skip marks, after first frame, series only.

More.description: The next part of a screen or a section.

MovedAddress.description: One row of the moved address table.

Nav.description: The menu for this class and profile.

NoAnswerReason.description: Why an http effect got no answer. Any status at all is an answer.

Notice.description: Text a client can draw with no other knowledge, including a client below the floor.

label.description: Label key, for clients with the strings.

text.description: Plain text in the viewer's language.

dropped.description: Attempts removed by the capability card.

more.description: True when more attempts may arrive through `/v1/play/{id}/more`.

PlayEvent.description: One thing that happened during play.

PlayEventName.description: What a play report says happened.

ProfileEntered.description: The profile answer names its home, so the core can map it to a target.

ProfileLimits.description: Needs a step up. Never reachable through a queued command.

ProgressState.description: A position, key by title and episode.

Rating.description: Rating words on the wire. Screens use the words like, love and dislike.

RatingState.description: Rating state of a title, versioned apart from its list state.

rating.description: Absent when no rating is set.

RefreshTrigger.description: Events after which a screen should be read again.

Rollout.description: A staged rollout. The bucket comes from the household, so a home moves together.

genre.description: The genre, for the genre screen.

next.description: A safe address to return to after sign in.

ScreenBody.description:
A page body handed to a screen. It stands in for the answer to an http effect whose
body was going to the screen.

request.description: Id of the http effect this answers.

stale.description: True when this copy is past its ttl and was kept for when the network is gone.

SeasonSummary.description: A season named on a title page.

Section.description: One row, hero, grid or notice of a screen.

cursor.description: Reads more of this section through `/v1/more/{cursor}`.

SectionKind.description: Section kinds. A kind this build does not draw falls back to a plain row.

ServiceState.description: State of a part of the service.

SessionView.description: Sign in state for screens. Tokens never appear here.

scope.description: Opaque scope of this account and profile, the same value http effects carry.

SettingKey.description:
Settings a queued command may change. Age rating and blocked titles are absent on
purpose: they need a step up, so a queued write can never touch them.

everywhere.description: True ends every session of this account.

SignedIn.description: Opaque tokens. `expires_in` is seconds, so no device clock decides anything.

StoreOp.description: Store operations. Only the offline layer uses store.

SubtitleBody.description: `/v1/subtitles/{file}`. The core checks `last_end_ms` against the driver's duration.

SubtitleFile.description: One subtitle file of a language, in the order to try.

Target.description: A semantic target. Each device maps it to one of its own screens.

TimeWindow.description: A span of a video the host compares to player time. Nothing ticks across the boundary.

seek_to_ms.description: Where a skip button moves to.

TimerOp.description: Timer operations. A clear uses the id of the timer it clears.

TitleKey.description: movie:<id> or tv:<id>. A bare id does not parse.

TitleKind.description:
The two kinds of title. Closed on purpose: a new kind reaches old clients only through a
dated transform, so a key always names a kind this build can open.

Track.description: One audio or text track, with the tag the manifest gave it.

VersionRange.description: The wire dates a server answers. Never compared for equality.

View.description: Changed screen state. A part that is absent did not change.

profiles.description: The account's profiles, for the picker. No PIN is ever held here.

WindowKind.description: Windows of time inside a video.

device.description: The token of a hosted device.

profile.description: An opaque member token on a session with an active profile.

service.description: The service token between server and finder.
